newsitem.title: UK: Charles' Parker Bowles to sell ornaments.
newsitem.headline: Charles' Parker Bowles to sell ornaments.

text.p: Camilla Parker Bowles, the divorced lover of heir-to-the-throne Prince Charles, is to sell family heirlooms at a London auction.
The auctioneers Sotheby's said the collection of 19th century urns, bowls, candlesticks and goblets are expected to fetch up to 16,000 pounds ($24,880) at a sale on on October 16.
The heirlooms were inherited from her maternal grandmother.
Princess Diana has blamed Camilla Parker Bowles for the breakup of her marriage to Charles, who has publicly admitted to committing adultery.
